scripts.generate:protocol: cargo run --quiet --manifest-path zeta-rs/Cargo.toml -p zeta-cli -- app-server generate-ts --protocol-version 1 --out desktop/generated/app-server/v1 && cargo run --quiet --manifest-path zeta-rs/Cargo.toml -p zeta-cli -- app-server generate-json-schema --protocol-version 1 --out schemas/app-server/v1.schema.json
